title: Finite-projective Hom complex with bounded coherent cohomology
statement:
Let $B$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $E^\bullet,G^\bullet$ be cochain complexes of $B$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] specialized to the one-point ringed site with structure ring $B$, and let $u\leq v$ and $a\leq b$ be integers. Assume $E^i=0$ outside $[u,v]$, each $E^i$ is finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], $G^j=0$ outside $[a,b]$, and each $G^j$ is finitely generated over $B$. Let $Q_B$ denote localization into the ordinary derived category $D(B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $C^\bullet=\operatorname{Hom}_B^\bullet(E^\bullet,G^\bullet)$, the module-valued total Hom complex [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex], so
$$C^t=\prod_{i\in\mathbf Z}\operatorname{Hom}_B(E^i,G^{i+t}),\qquad d_C(f)=d_Gf-(-1)^tfd_E.$$
The canonical comparison is an isomorphism
$$Q_B(C^\bullet)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\operatorname{Hom}_B(Q_BE^\bullet,Q_BG^\bullet)\quad\text{in }D(B),$$
where derived Hom is [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-object ringed site. Every $C^t$ is finitely generated over $B$, $C^t=0$ for $t<a-v$ or $t>b-u$, and every cohomology module $H^t(C^\bullet)$ is finitely generated over $B$.

source.place: Tag 0BZK, lemma-shriek-boundedness, proof: finite-projective Hom computation; more-algebra.tex Tag 0A66, lemma-RHom-out-of-projective.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-affine-projective-complex-derived-hom] with $R=B$, $P^\bullet=E^\bullet$ and $L^\bullet=G^\bullet$: $E^\bullet$ is bounded above by $v$ with projective terms, and $G^\bullet$ is bounded below by $a$. Fix the resolution $\eta:G^\bullet\to I^\bullet(G)$ used in [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. The representing comparison is induced by $\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(E,\eta)$: in degree $t$ it sends $(f_i)_i$ to $(\eta^{i+t}\circ f_i)_i$. Both ordinary Hom complexes have the module products and signed differential of [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex], so this is exactly the canonical comparison in the statement. The cited projective-complex Hom computation makes its localization invertible, giving $Q_BC^\bullet\simeq R\operatorname{Hom}_B(Q_BE^\bullet,Q_BG^\bullet)$.

source.place: Tag 0A66, lemma-RHom-out-of-projective, and its proof; one-point ringed-site specialization.

proof.text: Fix $i,t$ and choose generators $e_1,\ldots,e_r$ of $E^i$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Evaluation $f\mapsto(f(e_1),\ldots,f(e_r))$ is a $B$-linear injection $\operatorname{Hom}_B(E^i,G^{i+t})\to(G^{i+t})^r$: a map zero on all generators is zero on every linear combination. The target is finite: put each of a finite list of generators of $G^{i+t}$ in each coordinate, with zero in the other coordinates. Its image submodule is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-submodule-finite], since $B$ is Noetherian. Lift image generators along the injection; injectivity shows their lifts generate the Hom module. This also covers $r=0$ and a zero target.

source.place: Tag 00IK, lemma-Noetherian-basic, submodule assertion; explicit evaluation-on-generators application.

proof.text: In degree $t$ every factor with $i\notin[u,v]$ is zero, so restriction gives $C^t\cong\prod_{i=u}^{v}\operatorname{Hom}_B(E^i,G^{i+t})$, with inverse extension by zero [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex]. Each factor is finite by Step 2; putting its chosen generators into its coordinate gives a finite generating set of this finite product. If $t<a-v$, then $i+t<a$ for every $i\le v$ in the product; if $t>b-u$, then $i+t>b$ for every $i\ge u$ in it. All target terms in the respective case vanish, proving $C^t=0$ outside $[a-v,b-u]$.

source.place: Tag 0BZK, lemma-shriek-boundedness, proof: finite-complex calculation; explicit support and generators.

proof.text: The cycles $Z^t=\ker(d_C^t)$ are a submodule of the finite $B$-module $C^t$, so they are finite by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-submodule-finite]. The cochain identity [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] gives $\operatorname{im}(d_C^{t-1})\subseteq Z^t$. By the cohomology definition [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], $H^t(C^\bullet)=Z^t/\operatorname{im}(d_C^{t-1})$ is generated by the images of any finite generating list of $Z^t$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. This proves finite generation for every $t$, including the degrees where $C^t=0$.

source.place: Tag 00IK, lemma-Noetherian-basic; quotient generators applied to cycles modulo boundaries.
